decisions.reason: It fits the firm's floor-care system offer and its stronger 2024 web presentation suggests good commercial relevance and support potential.
Maintenance oil is a natural recurring aftercare product for wooden floors and supports the firm's strategy of offering complete solutions around installed floors.
This care product closely matches the installed base of oiled wood floors and its own 2024 page indicates the firm sees enough demand to give it higher visibility.
A moisture-protection underlay complements floor installation, strengthens system sales to trade customers, and remains strategically aligned with the core flooring business.
High-density underlay foam broadens the installation accessory range and is worth retaining because it adds value for installers and project buyers without moving far from the core offer.
An oak parquet floor is very close to the firm's main business, and in a growing market a core wood-floor product should be retained unless there is clear evidence of weak demand.
